how: The revised role accommodates both an early proposal without reported uptake and a later initiating call.
Repeated calls invite people to start, repair, finish, and persist with the drawings.
Starting the later project and calling for participants coincide in one post rather than form separately observed stages.
An appeal receives an explicit desire to help and a report of placing after instruction.
Members ask about the canvas and receive explanations of its rule and timer, followed by thanks or reported placing.
A willing newcomer's reported placement follows instruction in the same exchange.
A newcomer thanks the explainer and reports placing without asking anything further.
A short volunteering line that also asks where to work is not bare acceptance under the no-request definition.
A drawing call can receive humorous redirection without either acceptance or an explanatory reason for declining.
A builder explicitly judges the room too small to finish against resistance.
One participant admits withdrawing while praising the continuing work.
Reported withdrawal alone does not establish an interpersonal quarrel or the participant's reason for leaving.
A neighboring participant attributes their group's withdrawal to the arrival of bots.
Members propose a color change, fallback design, and priorities between the two drawings.
Participants report outlining, remaining mane work, a nearly completed logo, and a drawing under way.
An anchor coordinate and rough plan locate the parallel drawing for volunteers.
Coordinates and a rough plan do not establish that a pixel template settled the room's design choices.
A placer reports a disabled timer and about thirty placements during the anomaly.
A report of extra placements does not independently verify that every apparent pixel reached the shared canvas.
A participant recalls expecting vulnerability while contributors went to bed, yet reports survival until near the end.
A timer anomaly and reports of outside bots do not establish builder-operated scripts or spare accounts.
Organizing requests and external discussion do not establish formal order or its absence, nor test the global prevalence claim.
A project subreddit is named without establishing a planning chat, server, or decisions returned from one.
Public external-venue references do not establish concealed strategy or infiltration.
Members explicitly defend the nearly finished logo and clean changed pixels.
The planned-change reversal clause requires evidence of repairs conflicting with an agreed redesign, which lost-eye and clutter reports do not establish.
Finishing the mane is explicitly followed by the need to keep the drawing clean.
A participant attributes a threat to a German flag being built over the logo.
Manual upkeep and a timer anomaly do not establish a turn toward automated placement.
Builders choose a contested spot, narrow it, and propose alternatives while construction is ongoing.
Choosing or proposing alternatives does not by itself establish an executed relocation.
Proposed relocation and a conditional fallback design do not establish an executed move after loss.
Too few hands can lead to persistence and a compromise at the disputed site rather than stopping and moving.
Members offer a truce and report a cooperation-dependent agreement to build behind the parrot.
Disputed entry into occupied space can prompt bargaining while the mark is still being built.
Neighbors request non-destruction and a builder promises limited overlap.
Restraint can answer a proposed bargain before a settled boundary is demonstrated.
Prior help can explicitly motivate sparing neighboring artwork without a recorded border settlement.
An instruction to spare neighboring art credits that neighbor's earlier help.
Members consider and report requests for help from other communities.
Requests for outside help do not establish that other rooms actually supplied defenders.
Members offer border maintenance for space and later report cleaning neighboring work.
An offer to exchange border maintenance for space does not verify delivery caused by that bargain.
An alliance suggestion answered with openness to peace does not establish coalition membership or joint defense.
The visible alliance overtures leave completed coalition formation unresolved.
Defense and alliance overtures are visible without demonstrated coalition membership or mutual defense.
A speaker reports carrying a move-for-help proposal to the neighboring group.
Builders seek permission to construct within contested neighboring space at the element's smallest guest-request range.
Permission-seeking does not establish durable host rule, approval authority, or permanent guest status.
A cooperation condition does not explicitly identify who may bind the room or dispute their authority.
The conditional truce has no coded authority disclaimer or refusal that would instantiate the bounded arrow.
A member apologizes after hearing a neighboring group's account of withdrawal.
An answer to an apology values possible loss as the excitement of the event.
Valuing possible loss does not establish permission for every destructive act or agreement by the entire room.
Neighbor participation and help do not establish a speaker claiming membership in both groups.
A humorous drawing suggestion invokes existing fan identity.
Praise prompts correction and reuse of the room's collective name.
A participant laughs at a joke alteration of neighboring letters.
Reported amusement establishes reception of a canvas joke without proving authorship or a room-wide running gag.
Naming the football rival's outline fits the revised range's minimal prior-rivalry form.
The rival alert reports others' activity without explicitly calling for or claiming a local attack.
A project venue and recruitment do not establish how a new canvas collective was founded or organized.
An argument over sarcasm in football joking does not establish disputes over offensive language in canvas talk.
Mock football claims, rival punchlines, and reactions explicitly invoke the April Fools license.
Participants negotiate whether context suffices to mark sarcasm or explicit markers and moderator care are required.
Recruitment routes volunteers toward a dedicated project subreddit for discussion.
Routing can use an already visible project venue without establishing new venue creation or enforced host-wide containment.
Project-specific routing does not establish that a flood of calls caused a host boundary.
Dismissal and joke redirection do not state that canvas posts motivated sabotage of the room's own work.
Members praise the work and thank contributors.
Final-result posts explicitly credit both drawings as shared efforts.
Celebration includes correcting and reaffirming the room's collective name.
Recognizable work receives praise even while comments report renewed damage.
Participants record the ending, late progress, survival, and loss.
Celebration and retrospective reporting coexist without demonstrating that celebrating caused record preservation.
A participant makes a repaired representation after live placement has ended.
Editing a post-close representation must be distinguished from maintaining the original live canvas.
One repaired image does not establish participation in shared cleanup, version contestation, or correction of an event claim.
Final images do not establish a later canvas, adopted emblem, or continuing collective purpose.
Retrospective records appear without a coded decision to continue the effort elsewhere.
A person's wish to help does not establish arrivals, returning fans, or subscribers drawn by the mark.
Seeking visibility on the canvas subreddit does not establish addressing the team, creators, company, or press.
An alert about a rival outline and reported outside activity is not itself a local attack call.
A participant proposes taking over an existing carrot for the room's drawing.
A participant reports joining a contested fight while encountering active resistance.
A drawing call and humorous redirection do not establish recruited hands attacking a named rival.
Named resistance during encroachment is followed by explicit offers and a reported compromise.
A neighbor's deal request receives reassurance rather than a refusal answering an attack call.
A neighboring participant retrospectively attributes withdrawal to outside bots and their flag.
The retrospective visitor account concerns a later outside attacker rather than a rival contest generated by the room's encroachment.
